in_sanskrit.name: Anwita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, Beautiful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anwita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anwita is derived from the Sanskrit word anu-wita, meaning 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga and is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and happiness.
